verdict.rationale: UKVI's own pages say the Innovator Founder application is online by mandate ("You must apply online"), with separate in-country and out-of-country flows. Applicants can verify identity and submit documents and the application online through the UK Immigration: ID Check app. The founder-visa fees are published exactly by filing location. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that the fee is paid online within the same flow, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the full application completes end-to-end online.
